headline: Morepen Laboratories hits new high on heavy trading volume, up 191% in four months
hook: Massive volume drives three-digit four-month gains
summary: Morepen Laboratories shares reached a new high backed by heavy trading volumes, extending a strong rally that has pushed the stock up 191% over the past four months. The surge reflects heightened trading interest and strong momentum in the counter. Indian retail investors tracking pharmaceutical stocks should note the sharp price appreciation and volume spike.
why_it_matters: Sharp rally raises volatility risk for momentum investors
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / late buyers face volatility
